title: 3. Generate MCP tools
script: The descriptors now project through the official Python MCP SDK. Four different products become four endpoint-specific tools, each with an input schema derived from the observed parameters. The executor is shared. The host, method, path, and arguments come from data. This is the reusable marketplace pattern: RapidAPI supplies a common runtime envelope, while each provider operation supplies a typed binding. Adding a new supported capture should add data and evidence, not another handwritten HTTP client.
